jobs.title: Graduate AI Engineer
jobs.description: Graduate AI Engineer at Earth AI, Alexandria Sydney NSW (on-site). Responsibilities include building modular AI components, running experiments and validating outputs, writing clean maintainable Python code. Develop and evaluate machine learning models and AI agents using multimodal geological and operational datasets. Requirements: degree in AI, data science, computer science/IT with an AI/ML/data focus, or a related science or engineering field with a strong AI emphasis; knowledge of ML fundamentals, LLMs, and retrieval-augmented generation; proficiency in Python including NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch. Up to 2 years professional experience. Salary: $120,000–$130,000 per year. Early-stage critical metals exploration company, founded 2019, 12 employees.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description: MLOps Engineer at 7-Eleven Australia, reporting to the Head of Research, Analytics & Data Science. The MLOps Engineer will play a key role in helping our Data Science team deploy, operate and maintain machine learning and AI solutions in production. Initially, the focus is the operationalising and ongoing support of our strategic machine learning engine hosted in Databricks. Responsibilities: taking models from experimentation to production, building CI/CD pipelines, maintaining data and feature pipelines, diagnosing production issues, and supporting Generative AI and LLM applications; access controls and governance within Databricks. Requirements: strong Python and SQL skills, Azure Databricks experience (MLflow, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows), experience monitoring models in production including drift detection; CI/CD experience preferred, ideally Azure DevOps. Agentic AI and LLM deployment experience is a bonus. Location: Richmond, Melbourne VIC (Hybrid, 3 days in office). Base & super & bonus.

jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer (ML/AI)
jobs.description: Lead Machine Learning Engineer (ML/AI) at Additive Assurance, Oakleigh South Melbourne VIC. About the role: primary ML lead who takes end-to-end ownership of classification and 3D segmentation pipelines, with models deployed onto machines in the field. This is not a clean-data competition or academic research gig, since industrial sensor data is messy and edge hardware has real compute limits. Responsibilities: designing, training, and deploying deep learning models for classification, anomaly detection, and segmentation on image and 3D datasets; building preprocessing, filtering, and augmentation pipelines for sensor streams; working with the software team to put models into production and optimize inference for edge and cloud; benchmarking new architectures for real-time defect detection; root-causing model problems across hardware logs, raw sensor data, and pipeline code. Requirements: practical deep learning experience in PyTorch and computer vision, segmentation, or 3D data; strong Python and scientific-stack skills, plus Git, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD; valid working rights in Australia. Salary: $150,000 + super + equity. Hybrid, Oakleigh South Melbourne VIC. Posted September 2026.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Senior AI Engineer at FinXL IT Professional Services — deployed with a leading banking client on a 6-12 months contract in Sydney CBD. You will design, build, and deploy enterprise-grade Agentic AI and Graph-RAG systems; build knowledge graphs, multi-step agent frameworks, and evaluation guardrails; work with risk and governance teams. Requirements: production LLM experience, advanced expertise in Neo4j and Cypher, LangGraph or AutoGen, Python, and AWS; graph database modeling and knowledge graph integration using Neo4j is a key requirement. Exposure to APRA and Basel frameworks is highly regarded. Hybrid working model, 3 days/week in Sydney CBD. Up to $160k inc super p.a. or day-rate option. Posted November 2026.
